about_the_game: Get all the classes, tracks and content from Year 1 of Project Motor Racing with the Year 1 Season Pass. Race 5 fire-spitting icons from a wild, unhinged era of speed, noise, and excess from the Day 1 Group 5 Revival Pack. Then add an additional 3 Content Packs plus the Year One Expansion Pack and complete your motor racing experience.
